title: Possible race condition with lottie_enableMergePathsForKitKatAndAbove and lottie_fileName
body:
*Lottie is supported and developed on nights and weekends. Issues from [Lottie sponsors](https://github.com/users/gpeal/sponsorship) will be prioritized.*

**If you don't use this template, your issue will be closed. Delete this text once completed.**

**Checklist**

1. Fork this repository into your account.
2. Reproduce your issue in the issue-repro module. Issues without a repro in the issue-repro 
   module may be auto-closed.

**Link to fork with a repro in the issue-repro module**

with animation:

[animation.txt](https://github.com/airbnb/lottie-android/files/6537011/animation.txt)

I have default style for all LottieAnimationView
```

    <style name="LottieAnimationViewStyle">
        <item name="lottie_enableMergePathsForKitKatAndAbove">true</item>
    </style>
```

and this configuration in xml layout file for `com.airbnb.lottie.LottieAnimationView`
```
app:lottie_autoPlay="true"
app:lottie_fileName="lottie/animation.json"
 ```

Although merge path are enabled I have this log before crash
```
LOTTIE  Animation contains merge paths but they are disabled.
```

It is very hard to reproduce but from my brief investigation it seems that animation is loaded before `enableMergePathsForKitKatAndAbove` is set in constructor of `LottieAnimationView` - so it is technically possible (as this is done concurrently) to check this flag before it is set.

**Steps To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:

1. Go to '...'
2. Click on '....'
3. Scroll down to '....'
4. See error
